shipped_originals.title_o: Concept Mapping as a Retrieval Practice Activity

blind_target.evidence_quote: Karpicke and Blunt (2011) showed in college students that retrieval practice produced more learning from educational texts than concept mapping on a 1-week delayed test.
blind_target.outcome_quote: While the results essentially replicate Karpicke and Blunt's finding which shows that retrieval practice leads to better overall performance than concept mapping, this effect was less pronounced for people with experience using this technique than it was for trained participants.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication verdict. Attenuation for experienced participants does not turn support into mixed.

blind_target.evidence_quote: A recent genome-wide association study for type 2 diabetes in Han Chinese identified several novel genetic variants. We investigated their associations with quantitative measures to explore the mechanism by which these variants influence glucose homoeostasis.

shipped_originals.title_o: An Experimental Test of the Expectancy-Disconfirmation Theory of Citizen Satisfaction

blind_target.evidence_quote: Van Ryzin experimentally manipulated expectations and performance and found a direct effect of performance, but no disconfirmation. We performed: an exact replication; a conceptual replication with extreme manipulations; a conceptual replication that reversed the order of a performance and expectations manipulation.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Study 1 and 2 reproduced original findings. In contrast, study 3 indicates that expectation cues are retrospectively used to anchor prior experiences of performance.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Two replications agree, while the third is explicitly contrasted. Original bibliographic entry unavailable in abstract.

shipped_originals.title_o: The role of social and human capital among nascent entrepreneurs

blind_target.evidence_quote: We conducted a three-step replication of Davidsson and Honig’s study on the roles of human and social capital in venture creation processes.
blind_target.outcome_quote: We largely validate D&H’s findings, highlight the importance of modeling initial entrepreneurial processes, and emphasize the underappreciated complexities and value of replication studies.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Overall authors verdict largely validates the findings. Original citation title and reference-list authors are unavailable in abstract; do not reconstruct from external knowledge. Also reports exact reanalysis and changed specification, whose computational and robustness results cannot separately be resolved from this abstract.

shipped_originals.title_o: “Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?” The Effect of Thinking About Being Ostracized by God on Well-Being and Prosocial Behavior

blind_target.evidence_quote: Our research replicates a previous study, which examined how Christians being led to believe God will either include or exclude them influenced well-being scores.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract confirms the exclusion hypothesis but also reports an absent moderation; it gives neither the original results nor an overall replication verdict. It therefore cannot settle agreement across the original findings.
